proved_step:
statement: Let G=(V,E) be finite, d>=1, F a field, K a subspace of F^I with blocks I_v satisfying (R),(L),(E) of PNP-001-PAPER-BASIS-BLOWUP-v4.0 Sec.4, and B a finite spanning family of K. Then tw(H_B) >= d(tw(G)+1)-1, where H_B is the support-overlap graph of B.
derivation: Thm 4.1 gives an injection iota: V x [d] -> J mapping every edge of G[K_d] to an edge of H_B, so G[K_d] is a subgraph of H_B (non-edges need not be preserved). tw is subgraph-monotone (paper Sec.2). Lemma 2.2 gives tw(G[K_d]) = d(tw(G)+1)-1. Hence tw(H_B) >= d(tw(G)+1)-1. Consequence: if clauses 1-3 of Candidate A hold, then F(m,s,S_A,U_A) >= d(tw(G_{m,s})+1)-1; clause 4 is the negation of this and is dropped.
